title: b12500
description: cuda: decode the conv2d patch indices with fastdiv ( #32492 ) The implicit GEMM conv2d kernel recovers the channel and the kernel position of each reduction index with three integer divisions by runtime divisors, once per loaded row of every tile. Outside the 3x3 and 1x1 specializations this integer division bounds the kernel: removing it halves the time on long reductions. Divide with the precomputed magic numbers of fastdiv instead. title: b12493
description: cuda: use the implicit GEMM conv2d path for F32 kernels ( #32482 ) The fast CONV_2D path (implicit GEMM with MMA, or cuBLAS for pointwise convolutions) required an F16 kernel. F32 kernels fell back to the naive direct convolution, which is much slower than im2col + mul_mat on large channel counts. Convert F32 kernels to F16 in a pool buffer, as is already done for the input, and take the same path with F32 accumulation. The Metal implicit GEMM kernel already stages both operands as F16.
